paper_title: Search for sub-eV axion-like particles in a quasi-parallel stimulated resonant photon-photon collider with "coronagraphy"
coupling_convention: g/M in GeV^-1 (ALP-photon coupling), as plotted
notes: Laboratory light-by-light (stimulated resonant photon-photon collider) ALP search, model-independent. Most sensitive point g/M = 5.45e-7 GeV^-1 at m=0.15 eV for pseudoscalar ALPs. The paper presents exclusion contours (Figs 10, 11) for both scalar and pseudoscalar cases spanning roughly m ~ 1e-3 to ~1 eV, but only the single most-sensitive numerical value is given in text; the full curve is only shown in figures without tabulated points.
